page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8s.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, with 1 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory (2.0 GB per core) and a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU providing 8 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage and features a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average tier across several metrics. The Intel Xeon CPU delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1904.48 and a multi-core score of 28120.76, while Geekbench 5 yields a single-core score of 1590.0 and a multi-core score of 12813.0. Memory bandwidth reaches 1675.59 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 77.1 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. For specialized workloads, the instance achieves a Geekbench ray tracing score of 24018.0 and processes 31.3 million Redis SET operations per second. LLM inference benchmarks for a 7B model show prompt processing at 32.25 tokens per second and text generation at 12.06 tokens per second.

Given its fractional GPU allocation and dedicated CPU cores, this instance offers a cost-effective entry point for workloads requiring GPU acceleration without the expense of a full dedicated GPU. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which is a key architectural tradeoff. This configuration is suitable for entry-level AI/ML inference, virtual workstations, 3D rendering, and moderate compute-intensive tasks that benefit from hardware acceleration.
